questions.wording_verbatim: Have you ever used ChatGPT for any of the following? — For entertainment / To learn something new / For tasks at work

questions.response_options: Yes, I have done this / No, I have not done this

questions.response_options: Yes, I have done this / No, I have not done this

questions.wording_verbatim: Have you ever used ChatGPT?

questions.wording_verbatim: Have you ever used an artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot like ChatGPT, Gemini or Copilot?

questions.response_options: Yes / No / Do not know

NB: cycles 202521-202523 (Oct 6-Nov 16, 2025) were never collected due to the federal shutdown — a structural gap Census documents in the data dictionary; the old wording's last collection ended 2025-10-05.

questions.wording_verbatim: Do you use Generative AI for your job? (Preceded by module definition: "Generative AI is a type of artificial intelligence that creates text, images, audio, or video in response to prompts. Some examples of Generative AI include ChatGPT, Gemini, and Midjourney.")
questions.base_population: Employed US adults 18–64 in the Real-Time Population Survey (online panel weighted to CPS/ACS benchmarks); genAI module gated by an awareness screener (module skipped by the ~25.5% who had not heard of genAI)
questions.response_options: Yes / No
questions.break_note: Pilot Jun 2024; full module from Aug 2024. Authors' Oct 2025 revision: an Aug 2025 question-sequencing test showed earlier waves underestimated usage; a reweighting adjustment was applied to the 2024 and Feb/May 2025 waves (Aug 2024 overall: 39.4% initial -> 44.6% revised; see updated working paper appendix A.2.1 via the Fed post). Wave calendar per the same post: quarterly since Aug 2024 (pilot Jun 2024), i.e. Aug/Nov 2024, Feb/May/Aug/Nov 2025, Feb/May 2026.

questions.wording_verbatim: Combined measure from "Do you use Generative AI for your job?" and "Do you use Generative AI [outside your job]?" (both verbatim in the paper; same module definition as rps-genai-work)

questions.base_population: US adults 18–64 in the Real-Time Population Survey (online panel weighted to CPS/ACS benchmarks)
questions.response_options: Yes / No per component item

Wave calendar per the same post: quarterly since Aug 2024 (pilot Jun 2024), i.e. Aug/Nov 2024, Feb/May/Aug/Nov 2025, Feb/May 2026.

questions.wording_verbatim: In the last six months, did this business's employees use Generative AI to assist in any work-related tasks? Some examples of Generative AI include ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Dall E, MidJourney, and GitHub Copilot.)
